title: 2023 Scott Addict RC 40 - a total race bike package! With the new Shimano 105 di2

takeaways.text: The 2023 Addict RC 40 pairs the higher HMX-grade frame and fork with Shimano 105 Di2 and fully internal cable routing, plus lowered seatstays for compliance.
The US retailer put it at around US$5,000 in January 2023, before the aftermarket carbon wheels shown.

disclosure: Short walkaround by a US SCOTT retailer of a bike it sells; the wheels shown are an aftermarket ENVE upgrade.
summary: US retailer walkaround of the 2023 SCOTT Addict RC 40 with Shimano 105 Di2.
